description: This file defines an extension of the Bootstrap popover plugin called 'popoverext'. It adds additional functionality such as setting IDs, handling content and footer, positioning logic, and custom event handling tailored for project-specific needs.

classes.name: PopoverExt
classes.description: Constructor function for the popover extension, extending Bootstrap's tooltip.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the popover extension with given options and binds event handlers.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Populates the popover with title, content, and footer.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks whether the popover has any content to display.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Assigns an ID to the popover element if specified in options.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the popover with proper positioning and styling.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Retrieves the footer content for the popover.
